ms.report:
For this milestone we met with several different Lawyers from the US and from Japan. 
We we're fortunately able to confirm, more than one legal structure that are feasible and that we will be looking to develop during this proposal. While, we were initially expecting to follow just a single legal structure, we are willing as a company to invest more money to explore instead two different legal structures per jurisdiction, to empower our firm to choose the most optimal and cost efficient legal structure to be executed in practice. 
Considering this, we have also developed and shared a Roadmap for the Development of this service, considering the different legal structures we will be exploring.
Here you can find the different outputs we have committed to:

ms.report:
Hello Reviewers after doing a change request to update the delivery dates in our proposal we are re-submitting the same proof of achievement. Thanks for your contributions throughout all this process.
First we've done two forms, one for our Japanese users, written in Japanese, and the other Two for US and European Users:
Japan Form: https://forms.gle/yrRpHF1GTRdYknBB6
EU and US Form: https://forms.gle/5s2nDW3UrVQujPED9
Here you can find the excel with the answer, where we blurred emails as we don't have the permission to share personal user information: 
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kmYkuzPRKtS3TKrYMnnoTmMzBQoznsq_?usp=sharing
For the Contracts, we started with the idea of developing one contract that would cover the 3 jurisdictions (Japan, US, and EU) or one contract per jurisdiction for a total of 3 contracts. However, collaborating with the Lawyers, the best option was to create two different options per jurisdiction. One that is more educational , and the other one where we deliver the work in the name of the beneficiary. 
So in total, we are overdelivering and providing two contracts per jurisdiction, what helps explain the delay in submission of this milestone, as we had double the work, and significantly more costs that initially expected, which means we had to find a way to scrape the necessary funds to fund the extra work. Here are the contract templates:
US contracts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1R7S7bU45Bo59xiWsqcKqKKG8Qq13Tacn?usp=sharing
EU contracts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1x8_U5AEVGkcuBnCiX81ClKXuOsEbu9H8?usp=sharing
Japan Contracts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xgVO5KOc-EWipDh4mfG5zD_Bdg4qpiIG?usp=sharing 
Thank you in advance for you work in reviewing all this information, and for being an important part of making a decentralized Grants program like Catalyst a reality.
